agent_priors_used: Long-horizon agents accumulate compounding planning errors via path dependence and salience of first success biasing later retrieval, requiring explicit verification/UNKNOWN abstention (ECE<=0.15, precision>=0.85) to avoid stale-binding false_accept - prior distinct from SPIDER's measured false_accept 1.0 vs verbatim.

Retrieval quality saturates early; marginal gain shifts to post-retrieval adaptation and applicability verification (target-bound reconstruction) - flat top-k cosine leaves 40-50% stale-binding errors even when retriever is 95% accurate; motivates weighting reconstruction/false_accept over further retriever tuning.

Work compression (residual novelty economics) only observable with matched task families controlling novelty fraction and honest amortized cost (retrieval+reconstruction+verification+repair)/frequency; bijective formulas or single-site loops manufacture correlation - prior distinguishes FALSIFIED product result from genuine economics.

Mechanisms that survive commercially are model-agnostic and executable as state-machine/API endpoints with zero per-step LLM calls on warm replay and verify-before-store gate (8-13x speedups externally) - semantic similarity alone does not change work; informs requiring 0-token replay baselines and Pareto cost/latency reporting.
